       a) To temporarily allow unfree packages, you can use an environment variable

            $ export NIXPKGS_ALLOW_UNFREE=1

          Note: When using `nix shell`, `nix build`, `nix develop`, etc with a flake,

       b) For `nixos-rebuild` you can set
